protocol.C0_policy: Reuse complete formal native original scores and saved original responses; no new original-method inference.
protocol.family_scope: All frozen13905 inputs permodel; no outcome-based deletion. Exposed development, not independent.
protocol.failure_policy: Ordinary single-item errors retain denominator and continue; shared engine/unknown submitted state stops affected worker.
protocol.completed_union_policy: Complete per-arm denominator is completed_union plus newly produced tasks; never treat pending rows as removed.
protocol.cache_policy: Same input/request identity only; old F pool generated at most once for each missinginput and shared C1-C5; actual paid old costs remain separate from new physical costs.
protocol.scheduling: Role-major catalog/facts/readout then input-major contiguous arms. No facts pending: all adopted rulefacts cached.
protocol.freeze_scope: This freezes the full-v5 run only; independentconfirmation method/control freeze follows regression with explicit exposure ledger.
